dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent structures exhibit irregular, jagged 'O' and 'C' perimeters with sharp gradient transitions from high-intensity light-gray borders to low-intensity dark-gray interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of small, solid, high-intensity light pixels lacking internal gradients are concentrated in the mid-ventral and posterior-lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four largest dorsal annuli form an irregular quadrilateral; the three most central annuli define an obtuse triangle with its widest angle oriented toward the posterior flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of five distinct, roughly parallel, vertically-oriented linear scars of high-contrast light tissue are visible on the mid-right lateral flank.
